name: digital-waste-tracking-uat
description: User Acceptance Testing suite for Defra's Digital Waste Tracking service using Jest and API testing framework
author: Defra DDTS

scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.report:clean: rm -rf allure-results && rm -rf allure-report && rm -rf zap-report
scripts.source:clean:test:integration:report: . ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test:integration ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.source:clean:test:integration-zap:report: . ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test:integration ; npm run test:zap-gate ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.source:clean:test:uat:report: . ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test:uat ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.source:clean:test-name-pattern:report: bash -c '. ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test-name-pattern -- "$1" ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open' --
scripts.source:clean:test-location-pattern:repor: bash -c '. ./env.sh && npm run report:clean && npm run test-location-pattern -- "$1" ; npm run report:generate && npm run report:open' --
